title: Vampire Vape Vanilla Cappuccino Tobacco 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape Vanilla Cappuccino Tobacco Shortfill unites bold Tobacco with the mellow sweetness of Vanilla and the aromatic warmth of Cappuccino. The Tobacco provides the backbone, while Vanilla softens the profile and Cappuccino brings a roasted coffee note for added depth. Blended at 70VG/30PG, this 100ml shortfill is perfect for direct-to-lung (DTL) vaping with sub-ohm kits, producing thick vapour and smooth flavour. Supplied in a 120ml bottle with 100ml of nicotine-free liquid, it allows room for two 10ml nicotine shots to customise the strength. Made in the UK, Vampire Vape are trusted for their bold blends and reliable quality. This Tobacco collection demonstrates their skill at pairing traditional profiles with indulgent accents.
